facts.fact: A rainbow is actually a full circle; the ground simply cuts off the bottom. From a plane you can see the entire ring.
facts.angle: reframes something everyone thinks they know

facts.fact: Your stomach lining replaces itself roughly every few days, because the acid is strong enough that the stomach would otherwise start digesting itself.
facts.angle: your own body is doing something alarming right now

facts.fact: You are about a centimetre taller in the morning than at night, because the soft discs in your spine compress under your weight during the day.
facts.angle: a hidden daily change in your own body

facts.fact: A single teaspoon of a neutron star would weigh roughly a billion tons, because its matter is crushed almost beyond belief.
facts.angle: a number that sounds fake but is true

facts.fact: A day on Venus is longer than its year: Venus spins so slowly that one rotation takes longer than one trip around the Sun.
Saturn is so light for its size that it would float in water; it is less dense than water itself.
The Sun is about 400 times wider than the Moon and also about 400 times farther away, which is the only reason they look the same size and we get perfect eclipses.
facts.angle: a cosmic coincidence you never noticed

facts.fact: On Neptune and Uranus it likely rains solid diamonds, as extreme pressure squeezes carbon in the atmosphere into crystals.
We have mapped more of the surface of Mars than the floor of our own oceans; most of the deep sea has never been seen.
facts.angle: the unknown is right here, not in space

facts.fact: Most of the oxygen you breathe comes from the ocean, not forests; tiny drifting plankton produce well over half of it.
facts.angle: reframes where your air comes from

facts.fact: Everest is the highest point above sea level, but Mauna Kea in Hawaii is the tallest mountain on Earth measured from its base on the ocean floor.
facts.angle: the famous answer is technically wrong

facts.fact: A bolt of lightning is about five times hotter than the surface of the Sun, reaching tens of thousands of degrees in a fraction of a second.
facts.angle: everyday thing is more extreme than the Sun

facts.fact: Atoms are almost entirely empty space; if you removed it all, the entire human race would fit inside a single sugar cube.
Time runs very slightly faster for your head than your feet, because gravity is weaker further from Earth. It is tiny, but it has been measured.
facts.angle: time bends inside your own body

facts.fact: An octopus has three hearts and blue blood, and two of those hearts stop beating when it swims, which is why it prefers to crawl.
The tardigrade, a microscopic animal, can survive being frozen, boiled, crushed, and even the vacuum of outer space.
The mantis shrimp punches so fast it briefly boils the water around its claw, creating a flash of light and heat.
Sharks are older than trees. Sharks have existed for over 400 million years, predating the first trees by tens of millions of years.
Honey never spoils. Sealed honey found in 3,000-year-old Egyptian tombs was still perfectly edible.
If you laid out all the blood vessels in your body end to end, they would wrap around the entire Earth roughly two and a half times.
Your nerves carry signals to your brain at speeds of up to about 270 miles per hour, faster than a Formula 1 car.
facts.angle: your body is faster than you think

facts.fact: You carry roughly as many bacterial cells as human cells, meaning you are, by cell count, about half not-you.
The footprints left on the Moon will likely last millions of years, because there is no wind or water to erase them.
Space is completely silent. Sound needs a material to travel through, and space is a near-perfect vacuum, so no sound can exist.
The sunlight hitting your skin left the Sun about eight minutes ago, so you are always seeing the Sun as it was in the past.
facts.angle: you live slightly in the past

facts.fact: There are more stars in the observable universe than there are grains of sand on every beach on Earth combined.
Glass is not a slow-moving liquid. Old windows are thicker at the bottom because of how they were made, not because glass flows.
A blue whale's heart weighs about as much as a grown person, and its heartbeat can be detected from miles away.
facts.angle: scale of the largest animal ever

facts.fact: Some turtles can breathe through their rear ends, absorbing oxygen through their tissues to survive long winters underwater.
A hummingbird's heart can beat over 1,200 times per minute, and they are the only birds that can fly backwards.
facts.angle: extreme engineering in a tiny body

facts.fact: You shed tens of thousands of dead skin cells every minute, and much of the dust in your home is actually made of you.
About 8 million lightning bolts strike the Earth every single day, roughly 100 every second.
There is a vast cloud in space containing enough alcohol to dwarf anything on Earth, drifting near the center of our galaxy.
Bananas are slightly radioactive because of the potassium they contain, though you would need to eat millions at once for it to matter.
Your heart beats around 100,000 times a day, pumping blood through your body without ever taking a single break.
The human eye can distinguish around ten million different colors, yet we have names for only a tiny fraction of them.
facts.angle: the limits of language vs perception
